designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Antioch Dunes National Wildlife Refuge under the Endangered Species Act to protect endangered plants and insects.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act of 1973 (16 U.S.C. 1534); land acquisition by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Antioch Dunes National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
USFWS, Antioch Dunes NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (Aug. 2002), ServCat 1375: refuge established 1980 under the Endangered Species Act of 1973
Federal Register, Sept. 4, 2002: Availability of Final CCP for Antioch Dunes NWR ("Created in 1980")

review.note: Established 1980 by land acquisition under the ESA; first refuge for endangered plants and insects. Exact date not found.
